question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

People were ________ to safe places by the rescue team after the earthquake.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Evacuated**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling is "**evacuated**".
 
• It means to move people from a dangerous place to a safe place. (लोगों को खतरनाक स्थान से सुरक्षित स्थान पर ले जाना)
 
 
• **Example**: *The residents were evacuated due to the approaching hurricane.*
 
 
 
• The past tense of "evacuate" is "evacuated".
 
• The word is pronounced as "ih-vak-yoo-eyt".

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

**Complete sentence**: *People were evacuated __to safe places by the rescue team after the earthquake.*
